description: This header defines the 'ProxyServer' class for managing TCP proxy servers, along with related functions for executing proxies asynchronously or synchronously. It includes declarations for handling shared file descriptors and threading to facilitate data forwarding between client and server connections within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: ProxyServer
classes.description: A class managing the lifecycle of a TCP proxy server, facilitating start-up, shutdown, and thread handling.

methods.name: ProxyServer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the proxy server with a shared file descriptor and a client connection factory.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Blocks until the proxy server thread completes, allowing for graceful shutdown.

methods.name: Proxy
methods.description: Function to run a TCP proxy synchronously, accepting connections and forwarding data between client and target connections.

methods.name: ProxyAsync
methods.description: Function to start a TCP proxy asynchronously, returning a unique pointer to a ProxyServer instance.
